categories.main_business_segments: Organo Corporation operates two main business segments: Water Treatment Engineering and Functional Products. The Water Treatment Engineering segment includes plant engineering (ultrapure water production, water supply, wastewater treatment, resource recovery, and process-related equipment) and solutions (maintenance, consumables, operation management, and contract processing). The Functional Products segment covers water treatment chemicals (RO chemicals, wastewater chemicals, cooling water chemicals, cleaning agents, boiler chemicals), standard equipment and functional materials (ultrapure water devices, filters, separation/purification materials), and food ingredients/additives.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Organo's core technologies center on advanced separation and purification, including ion exchange resins, membrane filtration, and high-sensitivity water quality monitoring. The company develops and manufactures custom water treatment plants, ultrapure water systems, and high-performance chemicals, leveraging proprietary analytical, sensing, and process control technologies. Production emphasizes quality management, process automation, and continuous improvement, with R&D focused on high-purity, energy-efficient, and sustainable solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are in the electronics industry, especially semiconductor and electronic component manufacturers, which account for over half of total sales. Other key markets include general industry, social infrastructure (power, water utilities), and food processing. Major end users are large-scale manufacturers requiring ultrapure/process water, wastewater treatment, and resource recovery solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: Organo operates primarily in Japan, Taiwan, China, and Southeast Asia, with growing presence in the United States and other regions. The company has subsidiaries and production sites in Malaysia, China, Taiwan, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, and the US, enabling global project delivery and local support.
categories.supply_chain_position: Organo is positioned as a midstream to downstream player in the supply chain, providing engineering, equipment, chemicals, and maintenance services directly to end users in manufacturing and infrastructure. It sources key raw materials (e.g., ion exchange resins) from suppliers and integrates them into proprietary systems and solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding in the electronics sector (especially semiconductors), strengthening global presence (notably in the US), and enhancing the synergy between engineering and functional products. R&D focuses on high-purity water, advanced separation/purification, digitalization (DX), sustainability (CO2/waste reduction, water recycling), and new business models such as equipment ownership-based services. The company is also investing in human capital, digital skills, and ESG initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated from project-based sales of water treatment plants and systems, recurring sales of chemicals and consumables, maintenance and operation services, and equipment leasing/ownership-based service contracts. The business model combines one-time capital equipment sales with stable, long-term service and consumable income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Organo is a leading comprehensive water treatment engineering company in Japan and Asia, competing with other major engineering firms and chemical suppliers such as Kurita Water Industries, Hitachi, and Ebara. It is particularly strong in the electronics/semiconductor sector, with a reputation for advanced technology and high-quality service. The company is positioned as a technology-driven, value-added solution provider.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, Organo reported consolidated sales of 163.3 billion yen, operating profit of 31.1 billion yen, and net profit attributable to shareholders of 24.2 billion yen, with ROE at 21.7%. The company has shown strong growth, with sales and profits increasing significantly year-over-year, driven by robust demand in the electronics sector. The medium-term plan targets sales of 250 billion yen and an operating margin of 18% by 2031.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Organo differentiates itself through advanced separation and purification technologies, deep expertise in high-purity water and resource recovery, and integrated engineering-service-chemical solutions tailored to demanding industries like semiconductors. The company emphasizes sustainability, reliability, and the ability to deliver both large-scale projects and ongoing operational support, providing unique value in quality, compliance, and environmental performance.
